rules.title: GPS coordinates present
rules.description: The file contains GPS latitude/longitude data revealing the physical location where it was created.

rules.title: GPS altitude present
rules.description: The file contains GPS altitude data, which combined with coordinates narrows down the exact position, including floor level in multi-storey buildings.

rules.title: GPS timestamp present
rules.description: The file contains a GPS-recorded timestamp, indicating the exact time at the location where the photo was taken.

rules.title: Document author or creator name present
rules.description: The file's metadata includes a named author or creator, which may reveal a real person's identity.

rules.title: Last modifying user recorded
rules.description: The file's metadata records the account name of the person who last modified it, which may differ from the original author.

rules.title: Device owner name present
rules.description: The camera's configured owner name is embedded in the file, directly identifying the device owner.

rules.title: Windows user path exposed
rules.description: A local Windows filesystem path containing a username was found, revealing the account name of the machine that produced the file.

rules.title: UNC network share path exposed
rules.description: A Windows network share path (UNC) was found, revealing the hostname of an internal file server.

rules.title: Creating software identified
rules.description: The name and/or version of the software used to create or export the file is recorded in its metadata.

rules.title: Organisation or manager name present
rules.description: The file's metadata includes a company name and/or manager, revealing internal organisational structure.

rules.title: Timezone offset present
rules.description: The file's timestamp includes a timezone offset, which can help approximate the geographic location and working hours of the creator.

rules.title: Camera device identified
rules.description: The make and/or model of the camera or lens used to capture the image is recorded in the file's metadata.

rules.title: Device serial number present
rules.description: A unique hardware serial number for the camera body or lens is embedded in the file, allowing multiple files to be linked to the same physical device.

rules.title: Embedded EXIF thumbnail present
rules.description: The image contains an embedded EXIF thumbnail. If the main image has been edited or redacted, the thumbnail may still show the original, unmodified content — manual review is recommended.
